name: orchestra
description: A conductor agent and musician subagents for Claude Code, with a live ledger of who read and changed what, conflict and stale-read detection, and a coda built from the ledger.

narrateCoda.title: Narrate the coda
narrateCoda.description: When the conductor's turn ends with every part settled, Claude retells the coda as prose in a second file beside it. Each narration is one Claude call billed to your login, and needs `npm install` in the plugin's narrate folder.
